avis.texte: Got this cleanser to try out. Loved how it was a jelly but will say it doesnt do the best. I have had drugstore cleansers that do better than this one. For starters it doesnt even take off makeup. Use it for my second cleanse and have to go back in a third time to get everything off. Also says its fragrance free but to me does have a smell

avis.titre: Who knew jelly would be great for the skin.
avis.texte: I was nervous about if I was going to like this cleanser or not because of the jelly texture. I was nervous for no reason! It's great! Not only does it cleanse but it also removes makeup! A two-in-one! It also leaves my skin feeling so clean, bouncy and hydrated. Doesn't leave behind a tight, stripped feeling. Another great Bloomeffects product!

I'm usually someone that uses a cleansing oil or balm, and I don't think I've ever tried a jelly before this one. I really enjoyed this product. It removed both makeup and sunscreen really well. My eyes were not irritated after using it, nor did it leave them blurry. There was no weird residue left over one I rinsed the jelly off. My only qualm would be that it has a very strange scent. Because it's something that is rinsed off almost immediately, it doesn't bother me enough to not use it. Otherwise, I found everything about this product to be great.

I received the product from Buzz Agent. I used it to was my face. While using it my face never felt clean. It felt like there was a greasy film on it. It did smell really good but that's about all the good things ibhadvtovsayvaboutviylt.

I was very surprised by the cleansing power but gentleness of this cleanser. I have used a product like this and ended up not repurchasing bc I didn't feel like it removed everything and left a film. This gets everything off. I don't wear a full face of makeup but do wear sunscreen and light makeup. The really surprising thing was that my face was completely soft and undisturbed, if that makes sense. My skin is pretty sensitive and the barrier can get disrupted easily and then I break out but I can't use heavy products bc they don't clean and my pores get clogged. This is a pretty special cleanser. I do make sure and use each phase well and rinse well. There is no tightness at all. I'm super impressed! Wish they had a jumbo tube!

avis.titre: Not for sensitive skin or eyes
avis.texte: I eas looking for a first cleanser to remove makeup and decided to try this. I use Tatcha as my secondary cleanser. This does remove the makeup, but I felt like no matter how much I rinsed, it left a slightly oily residue behind which I wasnt a fan of as I have oily skin. What was more of an issue was how bad it makes my eyes burn. I have used many cleansers - Philosophy, IT Cosmetics, Clinique, Paula's Choice, Ordinary and Tatcha and never had a cleanser burn my eyes the way this one does. I thought the first time maybe I just didnt rinse well enough, but I have used the Bloomeffects 4 times now with the same problem. I also had a small reaction with a few small pimples the mext morning. This is a hard pass for me and I would caution anyone with any sensitivities.

Love how this product feels going on my skin. I also love that it is fragrance free. So easy to use, just add some water and the product goes on smooth and easy to remove. It melts into my skin and makes my skin feel fresh and clean. I would recommend this product.
This jelly cleanser left my skin feel so hydrated, I have really dry skin and it feels amazing after every use.
I enjoyed testing this product the application was easy with no hassle. It took off my makeup with no extra fuss it foamed up instantly and left no oily residue.

"As a dry/sensitive skin girly I usually don't wash my face in the mornings but this has been my go to for the past few days! Super gentle and effective leaves the skin feeling very clean and not stripped This is amazing for an oil based cleanser. It goes on like a jelly....Warms to an oil... and then add water for a milky cream that rinses off with no residue. Perfect."

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again
avis.texte: I use this daily as part of my skincare routine, and it's quickly become a staple for me. What I love most is how it cleans my skin without stripping it—my face feels fresh, soft, and actually hydrated afterward instead of tight or dry. It's gentle enough for everyday use, and I've noticed my skin looks more balanced overall.
This product really derails makeup. It is oil-based and very thick. It performs well, works a lot for dry skin

avis.titre: I love this product. I use it daily.
avis.texte: I am impressed at how easy it removes all of my makeup before getting face wet. I first used it on my dry skin It is smooth oil that easily lifts away makeup I especialy like how all of my mascara is removed with just soft wipe. Afterwards I just add warm water and it becomes a soft foam wash with a lght fresh scent . I love how soft my skin feels. This is the first time I have tried a new product that I like better than the product I have faithfully been using over 40 years. The same poduct I grew up watching my mother use. I believe its time to retire it and give my face a fresh new start; I will be buying more for myself and my daughters. I know they will love it too.

avis.titre: Wonderful Double Cleansing Wash for My Face
avis.texte: I received this product for free in exchange for writing a review. The Bloomeffects Royal Tulip Cleansing Jelly is my new favorite double washing cleanser. Gel cleansers are my absolute favorite, and this product fits that category. It has a particular smell - smells like saltine crackers and then slightly flowery, but the main thing is that my skin likes it. I have extremely acne-prone skin at 39 years old. If it has any irritating ingredients, I will know before the end of the day. I have not had any reaction to this cleanser. Since trying this product, I have stopped using my previous second cleanser in the evening. I did try using this cleaner for initial cleaning, and I didn't care for this order l. I felt like it didn't work as a stand-alone cleanser, but it definitely removed all of my makeup as a follow-up cleanser. I highly recommend trying the Royal Tulip Cleansing Jelly by Bloomeffects.

avis.titre: Leaves my face, feeling clean and fresh
avis.texte: This cleanser takes off makeup with ease! No more washing my face more than once, all the makeup comes off the first time around. A little cleanser goes a long way just add a bit of water to it. It leaves my face feeling clean, smooth, and silky. I would absolutely buy this cleanser again!

BLOOMEFFECTS recently gifted me this product in exchange for my honest review. Their Royal Tulip Cleansing Jelly is a gentle cleanser that effectively removes grime and makeup. It has a jelly-like texture that turns into a silky oil when applied to the skin. Adding water emulsifies it into a milky cleanser that feels very hydrating. My dry skin loves the nourishing, moisturizing properties of this product. It completely cleans my skin leaving it so soft, supple and smooth. I also love that I can safely use this cleanser around my eyes to remove my eye makeup. This is a wonderful product that I highly recommend.What makes it special is the proprietary Dutch Tulip Complex, packed with antioxidants, amino acids, and natural moisturizing factors from upcycled tulips. It's blended with hyaluronic acid, strawberry and sour cherry seed oils, plus a touch of malic acid for gentle brightening. The formula never strips my skin—instead it helps strengthen the barrier and leaves it plump and dewy. It's fragrance-free, paraben-free, and great for sensitive or dry skin. I've been using it as a double cleanse in one step and my face feels so much softer and more hydrated afterward. Definitely a new staple!

To begin, I should state that I probably wear more foundation than the average person. I'd say I fall somewhere in the middle. When I take off my make up, it can sometimes be a tall order. With that being said, the Royal Tulip Cleansing jelly was up to the task. My favorite part, in addition to it getting the job done, is how it foams when you first activate it. You can tell right then that something is happening. I would say my least favorite part is the smell. To me, it does not have a good one. I like my product to either not smell at all or to have a faint floral scent. In my opinion, this smells...not good. I'll leave it at that. It isn't overwhelming, I just have no desire to breathe it in. Overall, I would purchase it depending on the price.

avis.titre: Definitely adding this to my nightly routine!
avis.texte: I used the product in my nightly routine to remove my make up and wash my face. I will admit I was skeptical at first, but gave it a shot. I was completely blown away. Not only did it clean my face well it removed my waterproof mascara with no issues!! It feels face feel soft and hydrated. Will definitely be using this one regularly. It doesn't sud up much to my surprise, but it gets the job done!

avis.titre: I would not purchase this item
avis.texte: I liked the idea and consistency of this product. However this product made me break out horribly. I stopped using it waited a few days and tried it again. Yet again I had breakouts. Not a fan of this product.

I liked how well this product broke down my eyeliner and mascara making it easy to remove. It was too greasy to use on the rest of my face though, so I would just stick to using this as an eye makeup remover.

Most cleansers I have used leave my skin feeling dry and tight, but I could tell the first time using this cleansing jelly, that would not be the case here! First thing I noticed was the lack of fragrance- yes!! So many times cleansers have some type of perfume/scent which becomes irritating. I used it first to melt off my makeup, and though it did a great job on everything bit my mascara. I do use a waterproof mascara, and found that I still needed to use a targeted eye makeup remover. What i did love though was how the cleanser transformed with just a little water into this beautiful, milky cleanser. Once I was through cleansing, my skin felt juicy, plump and refreshed!!
I really like this makeup remover. The texture is thick and oily. However, if you let it sit for a few mins before removing your make up it comes right off!
Loving the gel formula! It goes on so light and rinses off so clean. My skin feels soft, not stripped. Perfect for mature skin.

I like how you can use this with or without water. Without water it's like a jelly base that helps to remove your makeup. With water it gets a little foamy like a face wash. After using this product I did feel like my face felt soft or almost like a layer was left on. I couldn't tell if that was how the product was supposed to make your face feel. I did feel like it was a little harder to take my eye makeup off. But all in all it wasn't a bad cleanser.

I live in the desert so I sometimes buy make up that is waterproof and does not run due to the heat here. For this reason, the makeup I wear, does take a little more time for me to remove all of it and even so, it still does not fully come off unless I shower. I do have to say that this jelly was absolutely amazing in removing a blackest of black, waterproof mascara. The jelly is thick, but a perfect kind of stand still thick. It is not greasy at all, it feels more sticky but in a good way. It is also not scented which was great for me to use around me eyes. It does not run and it does not feel weird. You only need a small amount to place on the area in which you are wanting to use it. This stuff works immediately. For mascara, I just closed my eyes, dabbed a small amount of jelly on my lashes and lightly massaged it in. The first time I used it, I did not know what to expect, but this really did the best job removing everything in a quick amount of time, without any irritation. It was amazing how when I started massaging the jelly in, that it turned into a milky, more runny liquid so it was easy to cleanse off. It was like magic. And now, I don't use anything else because this truly does the trick. This also worked for a lip stain and thicker lip gloss, as well as foundation. This is some great stuff to use for removing make up and I highly recommend to anyone looking for something that works and something that is super unique.

avis.titre: Adding this to my nighttime routine!
avis.texte: This product is great to use during your nighttime routine especially before the shower or if it is a busy night and you are a morning shower person. It's satisfying to feel the makeup melt away as you use it without water. The feel does feel moisturizing but if not rinsed properly can leave skin feeling oily. I would avoid contact to close to the eyes although it does work wonders on removing mascara without leaving black residue around the eye area.
I used this for 10 days. I just don't feel like this product works any better than others. I would buy this again if it was on sale.

I received this product as a sample to try. I really enjoyed the soft velvety texture and that it was fragrance free. This removed waterproof mascara completely, no left over residue. It went on easily, not harsh in any manner while cleansing, and rinsed off easily leaving my skin soft, moisturized, and glowing.

avis.titre: A must have for your daily routine!
avis.texte: Pros: 1. Fragrance free- no overwhelming scent. 2. Cute dip dye packaging 3. Goes on silky smooth like a serum. Cons: 1. Takes about a nickle to.quarter size amount of product to get your face clean. This is why I took away one star.

It's a thick, luxurious and creamy cleanser. It feels so smooth and silky when you apply it. The name made me anticipate a light floral scent but I was pleased to discover it was unscented. It didn't remove heavier make-up (evening event) fully but it was great at removing my normal daily make-up. It works well for me, I'll just start with a make-up removing wipe as needed. Apply it to your face and then add water to turn it into a milky cleanser. I also gently wipe my face with a warm, damp, soft cloth. This is the first product I've tried from this brand and I love it. I look forward to exploring their other products!

avis.titre: I would not purchase this product again
avis.texte: I've been using the bloom effects cleansing jelly royal tulip for a few days now it does smell good and seems to clean, but I find my skin is drier than normal. For this reason I would not purchase this item again.
This product didn't work for me. It left a layer of oil in my face that I had to go in with toner and remove. The jelly smelled good but didn't not clean my face.

I got this product free through the BzzAgent sampling program. It's an interesting concept, it comes out a jelly and turns into an oil once on your skin. While I want to love it, it unfortunately just became a greasy mess for me. It did take my make up off but I didn't feel like I could ever completely rinse it off my skin. It just felt heavy and my skin never felt clean.

This cleansing jelly from Bloom Effects works really well clean my face while leaving my skin so soft and refreshed. The jelly cleanser lathers well and feels nice while applying to my skin. It removes makeup really well. I would highly recommend this face cleanser.

This is labeled as a one product double cleansing jelly. First I love its texture and it makes my face feel amazing. It's thick and luxurious yet creamy and thick. It feels like rubbing liquid silk on my face. I cannot use it alone if I have full face of makeup, if that's the case then I need to use a wipe of makeup remover first and get most off before using this jelly cleanser. If I did a light makeup day I can use only this. Either way I'm a huge fan and will likely keep it in my bathroom. You apply it to face well and then add water to turn it into a milky cleanser and then wash wash. I usually go over my face with a warm cloth. This is the first thing I've tried from this brand and I'm very impressed and look forward to exploring the brand more.

BloomEffects sent me the Royal Tulip Cleansing Jelly for free through the BzzAgent sampling program so I could try it and share my thoughts. I've been using it as my daily cleanser and really like the lightweight jelly texture. It feels very gentle on my skin but still removes dirt and impurities well. My skin feels clean, soft, and hydrated after rinsing, without that tight feeling some cleansers leave behind. Overall, it's a great gentle cleanser for everyday use.

I have a love/hate relationship with this cleanser. It works very well - pulls oil, makeup, etc. out and off your skin without any suds, but it also makes my skin feel incredibly oily afterwards. The feeling goes away after using toner, but I'm not a big fan of that. I don't think my oily skin type is the target audience for this product, but I definitely see how well it works and how those with normal to dry skin would absolutely love this. It's very gentle, not drying, and isn't scented. So if you have sensitive skin, it's perfect.

I had the opportunity to try the Bloomeffects Royal Tulip Cleansing Jelly. I had never heard of this product and liked the results. The cleanser can be used on wet or dry face, but it gives a differing composition depending on the way you use it. I mainly used it with wet skin. I liked the outcome and did not feel that my face was overly dried or tight, as can happen with other cleansers. This manufacturer was new to me and I am interested to see other products. Definitely worth a try. I received this product free, in exchange for my honest review.

As a dry/sensitive skin girly I usually don't wash my face in the mornings but this has been my go to for the past few days! Super gentle and effective leaves the skin feeling very clean and not stripped at all.

avis.titre: Unique balm-like cleanser the really cleans
avis.texte: I've been really enjoying this cleanser. The texture is especially fun to use. It has a balm-like consistency that melts into the skin, similar to a cleansing balm, but it doesn't feel heavy or oily like most of them do. It's very effective at removing makeup. What really sets it apart for me is how it rinses off. Once you emulsify it with water and wash it away, it feels like it's completely gone...no oily film or residue left behind, which is something I often notice with other cleansing balms. My skin just feels clean and comfortable. Overall, it's a really pleasant product to use. The texture, performance, and the way it leaves my skin feeling make it one I look forward to using.

avis.titre: Great product, definitely would buy it again!
avis.texte: I received this product for FREE in exchange for my honest review. I've been using the Royal Tulip Cleansing Jelly for about two weeks now, and overall I'm really happy with it. I really like the texture, the jelly consistency feels very pleasant on the skin and melts when you massage it in. It also has a fresh, light scent that makes the cleansing routine feel very nice. I was impressed how well it removes even long-wearing makeup. It melts everything down very easily without much effort. The only thing I personally noticed is that it leaves a slightly oily film on the skin. Because of that, I prefer to follow it with a second cleanser as part of a double-cleansing routine. Overall, I'm satisfied with the product and think it would be especially great for people with dry skin, since it feels very nourishing and gentle.

The Bloomeffects Royal Tulip Cleansing Jelly is a gentle face cleanser with a soft jelly texture. It helped remove my makeup, dirt, and oil without making the skin feel dry. When you add water, it turns into a light milky wash. It leaves the skin clean, smooth, and hydrated.

avis.titre: Honest Review: Bloomeffects Royal Tulip Cleansing Jelly
avis.texte: I received the Bloomeffects Royal Tulip Cleansing Jelly in exchange for my honest review. After using it for a while, I can say the texture is one of the most unique things about this cleanser. It starts as a thick jelly and melts into an oil when massaged into the skin. Unfortunately, this cleanser wasn't a great fit for me. I found it to be very oily, and even after rinsing, my skin still felt like there was a residue left behind rather than feeling fully clean. I also tried using it both on dry skin and with water, but neither method completely removed my makeup. It also never really transformed into a milky cleanser for me the way I expected — it mostly stayed oily. I found myself needing to use quite a bit of product just to feel like I was doing something to my face. While I like the concept behind the product, it didn't perform as well as I hoped for removing makeup. I ended up needing a second cleanser afterward to fully clean my skin.
I cleansed my face daily using the bloomeffects cleanser. I liked the final feel of my skin . But I was disappointed with the lack of lathering .

avis.titre: I Don't Think You Ready For This Jelly!
avis.texte: I really enjoyed using this. It really melts away makeup with stripping your skin or making it feel dry. The jelly texture is very soft and smooth on the skin. After using my skin feels very soft and hydrated. A little goes a long way and it rinses off nicely without leaving a greasy residue. 10 out of 10 recommend!

avis.titre: Would recommend to Family and friends as a must have!
avis.texte: I've used this product for about 7 days now and it works great! It cleans well and doesn't leave skin feeling dry or sticky. It has a very mild smell and you only need a little to clean your whole face!

I 'll be the first to admit, I AM A SKINCARE SNOB. Not only that but I am a creature of habit. I have used the same cleansing balm for almost a decade without ever trying anything different. When I received this from BzzAgent, I thought to myself about what the worse that could happen was. I have pretty sensitive skin and eyes and almost every balm cleanser I have used leaves a hot tamale feeling in my eyes. I love that this has NO strong fragrance and rinses off VERY easily. Although it is very thick, after using it my skin is left feeling clean and hydrated without feeling heavy. This also has not caused any new breakouts or pimples to flare up. I am shocked to say that I have repurchased this and am happy to share I am now spending a fraction of what I spent before. It is now a staple in my skincare routine.

I absolutely love this cleanser! It does a great job getting everything off from the day without leaving my skin feeling overly stripped. I have combination skin and it can get super dry in the winter but this cleanser left my skin feeling clean and refreshed while still maintaining moisture.

Face felt clean and fresh right after use. I didn't not feeling any tightness or dryness like most facial cleansers that I have used in the past. I also liked that there was not a strong frangrance as that can be really irritating for my sensitive skin. Overall, I would recommend.
I actually was really surprised how clean and soft my face was after use. I followed the directions and it left my face feeling rejuvenated.

Loved this! You don't have to wash your face twice with two different products, which is always greattt! Left my face feeling soft and clean. I have oily skin and they left my face feeling clean but not dry

This is a lovely, luxurious cleanser that is probably made for much much drier skin than I have. I used it to double cleanse (wash makeup off, then wash skin) and I felt like I had a film on my face. Even after rinsing well and using a foaming face wash after, I woke up in the morning with many whiteheads which haven't been an issue for me.

avis.titre: Good product but scent was strong
avis.texte: I liked the product in itself. I'm a redhead with pretty sensitive skin, so a lot of cleansers end up stripping too much. This one felt moisturizing and didn't leave my skin irritated. The scent wasn't my favorite though--it was a little too floral for me.

I received a sample of Royal Tulip Cleansing Jelly to try and have been using it for about 2 weeks now. The jelly itself is very creamy and there is no scent so if that's important to you, this is a winner. My face feels clean without feeling dried out and I have not had any breakouts while using the Cleansing Jelly. I will continue to use this in my facial cleansing routine and definitely recommend, especially if you are sensitive to scents and don't like your face to feel dried out after washing.
Although this cleaning jelly got most of the makeup off my face, it broke my skin out after 3 uses. My skin does not like something about the formula for some reason.

I've been using this cleanser for a fees weeks now and it's been great, especially for removing make up. I really is able to break down product already on your face as well as sunscreen. It doesn't leave my face feeling stripped either. I prefer to use it without water at first and then add water to really get it to emulsify.
This product has a light, floral scent. It glides on smooth and doesn't leave a sticky residue. This is a lightweight product that leaves the skin feeling baby fresh and clean.

Disclosure: Thanks Royal a tulip Cleansing Jelly for the free Royal Tulip Cleansing Jelly. First Impressions: I have tried many facial cleansers over the years and had almost given up on finding one that works well for my needs. My two biggest issues are cleansers that don't fully remove mascara and those that sting my eyes. Because of this, I was initially skeptical about trying the Royal Tulip Cleansing Jelly. Texture & Application: One of the first things I noticed was the thickness of the gel. I actually loved this feature because the product stayed in place and didn't run into my eyes. I was able to apply it, close my eyes, and let it sit briefly without experiencing any stinging or irritation. Effectiveness: After rinsing, most of my mascara was already removed. The small amount that remained wiped away easily without excessive rubbing or irritation to my skin. This is especially helpful for me because I have short eyelashes, which usually makes removing mascara more difficult. Skin Feel & Ingredients: The cleanser is non-scented, which I appreciate. It also didn't dry out my skin. After washing it off, my face felt clean without any greasy or heavy residue. Usage Tips: At first, I used too much product. After a few uses, I realized that about a dime-sized amount is more than enough to effectively cleanse my face and eye area. Final Thoughts: Overall, I was impressed with the Royal Tulip Cleansing Jelly. Its thick texture, gentle formula, and ability to remove mascara w

I enjoy the texture and feels nice when washing your face. Removes makeup well and very gentle. While not drying, it also doesn't make my skin feel super moisturized either. Need to wash with another face wash and add moisturizer to feel complete.
Such a great multi tasking product that hydrates and cleans my dry skin!!

avis.titre: Luxurious and no drips down the arms!
avis.texte: ​Best for: Sensitive sensory needs, dry skin, and anyone who hates a messy sink. ​If you struggle with the "sensory nightmare" of water dripping down your arms while washing your face, this is for you. This jelly is a total game-changer because you apply it to dry skin, meaning you don't need a ton of water to get a deep clean. ​The texture journey is incredible—it starts thick and luxurious, then transforms into a gorgeous, oily "slip" as you massage it in. It melts everything away without any tugging. It's the first cleanser I've found that feels like a high-end spa treatment without the overstimulating mess at the sink. Truly a "no-drip" holy grail!

avis.titre: Cleanse my skin leaving it soft and hydrated
avis.texte: Royal Tulip Cleansing Jelly is 2-in-1 cleanser. I love how it melts away all the makeup easily without leaving my skin dry. And then add some water and its turns into milky cleanser giving soft and clean face. I was gifted this product.

I've been really impressed with this cleansing jelly! The texture is silky and lightweight, and it melts away makeup so easily and is not harsh at all. I've been using it as the first step in my double cleanse, and it does an amazing job breaking everything down before going in with my second cleanse. A little goes a long way, and it rinses clean without leaving any greasy residue, but leaves my skin feeling soft, hydrated and luxurious - never tight or stripped. My skin just feels so fresh and balanced afterward. Definitely a cleanser I've been reaching for every day!

This cleansing jelly works really well and leaves my skin feeling clean, soft, and refreshed. It melts away makeup easily without being harsh or stripping my skin. I especially love that it's fragrance-free, which is perfect for my sensitive skin. The texture is smooth and gentle, and a little goes a long way. Definitely a great cleanser that I'll keep using!

I don't have many cleansers that I can use dry like a cleansing oil or wet like a cleansing gel. But this product allows you to do both and I think that that is really unique. The texture of this product is very light and easy to spread over the skin. I think it does a great job of breaking down makeup and skin care from the day. I can feel an oil emulsion after rinsing this off, so I think people with dry skin would really love this product.

​The First Impression: First off, the packaging is stunning. It has that soft-touch, premium feel that looks beautiful on a marble vanity. But what really surprised me was the texture—it's a thick, cushiony jelly that feels incredibly luxurious the second it hits your skin. ​The Performance: I used this to break down a full face of makeup, and it performed like a dream. It starts as a jelly, melts into a nourishing oil, and then milks up slightly when you add water. ​Makeup Removal: It dissolved my stubborn mascara and SPF without any aggressive scrubbing. ​The Finish: My skin is typically prone to feeling "tight" after washing, but because this is packed with 68% lipids and their proprietary Dutch Tulip Complex, my face felt hydrated and "bouncy" instead of stripped. ​The Verdict: If you have dry or sensitive skin, this is a game-changer. It's fragrance-free (which I love for my skin barrier) and feels more like a spa treatment than a chore. It's the perfect first step for a double cleanse or a standalone morning wash for a dewy glow. Pro Tip: Apply it to dry skin first to let the oils really grab onto the makeup before adding water!
It really did seem like it melted the makeup off my skin. It took care of the water proof mascara as well. No residue was left. My skin felt clean when it was done. Very fresh and lively.

I found this cleanser to be effective in removing makeup and sunscreen without leaving my skin feeling stripped and dry. I did find that it was too heavy for every day use. I don't think it has any anti aging benefits which I like to have in my products but I think I will keep using it to get off the products at the end of the day.

This lathers well, and makes the skin feel soft with no leftover residue. Little to no fragrance. Love that it's all clean ingredients. Doesn't bother the eyes when removing eye makeup. Almost took off a star because I don't think it completely removes my mascara but that's okay.

The texture is unique. It stars as a jelly and melts into a silky oil that breaks down makeup. Once water is added the cleanser turns into a milky cleanser. After double cleansing my skin feels soft and clean. Only gave 4 stars because it burned my eyes a little more then my usual oil cleanser and didn't completely remove my mascara.

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. I'll be honest, I was expecting it to be just a nice cleanser. I read the instructions and learned to use the jelly to remove makeup by massaging it onto dry skin first. And I was amazed at how well it removed makeup. My skin felt refreshed, thoroughly clean and not stripped after using this product. No overpowering smell or residue either. I am now a HUGE fan and will definitely be repurchasing.

I was pleasantly surprised by how well this product worked for removing makeup. It is probably the best makeup remover I have tried and the first one I've tried in a cleanser like this one. It made my face very soft and glowing

I am delighted to be chosen to review this product for BzzAgent. First off, the packaging is absolutely stunning & sleek. Product is a thick serum/almost gel-like consistency & is maybe lightly scented (I find the scent not to be offensive). I really like the concept of using this as a double cleanse but really couldn't get the gist of the first cleanse despite using other similar cleansing oils without issue. I had better luck using on wet skin but still felt some residue on my skin after rinsing, which I don't love.

I received a free sample of Bloomeffects Royal Tulip Cleansing Jelly in exchange for an honest review. I have used it daily for almost 2 weeks, my skin feels fantastic. Having never experienced dry skin until recently, my 54 yr young skin loves it. It is perfectly balanced, not too oily, not dry at all. You can massage it on dry face and the makeup just melts away. Or wet your face and apply and it turns into a fantastic creamy cleaner. I will definately keep purchasing.

Royal Tulip Cleansing Jelly is a must because it's a double cleanser with only one product. It is so hydrating yet deep cleans. My face feels so soft and smooth after using this. I also have sensitive skin and my face is not irritated but feels relaxed after using this. This formula just melts into your skin and removes all makeup. I love how it goes from the jelly cleanser to a milky cleanser with just water.

I have tried other products from this brand so I was excited when I was selected to receive a sample. Skincare can be such a drag so a 2 in one product was a no brainer. Sadly I couldn't remove my makeup effectively with this. I tried multiple nights and each time I had to reach for another facial cleanser to remove my makeup.

I have been trying out this cleanser for the past few days and I absolutely love it. The consistency is great - it comes out as a jelly cleanser, but when you apply it to your dry face, it melts down to an oil that melts away makeup. I double cleanse, but with this product, you truly don't need too. I wake up with a fresh soft face. I received this product for free in return for an honest review.

Royal Tulip is a pink jelly cleansing that helps loosen up your makeup. The jelly transforms into an oil consistency as you rub in to your skin. It says it double cleanse with one product, but not for me I still had to wash my face with my face wash.

Just to start, I wasn't to state that I don't use makeup, so I can't review on how well it works to remove it. With that being said, I thought this cleanser was just okay. It did clean my face pretty well, but it was nothing special compared to my normal cleanser. It might work better as a makeup remover compared to and every day cleanser. I would recommend trying because it does have a nice consistency and cleans well, and it might work better for others since everyones skin is different.
Easily removed dirt and makeup with a clean rinse and no sticky feeling afterwards.

I really wanted to like this product - I love a good makeup-melting cleanser. That said, I did not feel that this product did much by way of cleaning. The consistency out the gate was nice - definitely has the jelly cleanser feel, and I love that it's not a scented product. However, the product did not "do" much once I actually tried to use it - I definitely had to re-cleanse after initially cleansing with this product.
Feels good on the skin. Very hydrating and moisturizing. Didn't irritate my skin like some products do.

avis.titre: Convenient 2 in 1 makeup remover and cleanser
avis.texte: I was excited to try this 2 in 1 makeup remover and face cleanser. The oil does remove a light makeup very well. If you are a heavy makeup wearer I'm unsure if it would do the job, but for me it was perfect. Adding the water does create a nice cleanser, but when rinsing I did still feel a bit of the oil on my face, which might not be for everyone and could make you want to cleanse your face again. I noticed no scent and my sensitive skin did not have a bad reaction to the product, so I'd consider this decently safe for most skin types. I will use this bottle but I'm unsure if I would buy again.

At first glance the packaging is feminine and pretty. I liked that is was fragrance free! The description of the cleanser being a jelly and transforming into an oil is spot on. It was easy to apply and have my makeup melt off. The only thing I didn't love about it is the residue it leaves on the skin. It almost reminds me of other oil based makeup removers we used in the 90s, although definitely lighter in texture. It's also a plus that it's made in the USA!

BLOOMEFFECTS Royal Tulip Cleansing Jelly Honestly, I didn't notice anything special about this product. The texture is really soft and pleasant, and it spreads easily over the skin. The scent is light and unobtrusive, which is a plus for those sensitive to fragrances. It cleanses well, but without any "wow" factor. It removes makeup only averagely, and long-lasting makeup will likely require additional cleansing. Overall, it's an average product that does its job, but I wouldn't repurchase it or recommend it.

avis.titre: Smooth, moisturizing and cleansing in one
avis.texte: This was my first experience with Bloom Effects cleansing jelly. I love how it both moisturizes and takes my make up off. It is gentle on my skin and does not irritate around the eyes which is important for me as most of the tricky make up that takes more cleanser is around the eye area. Easy to remove mascara and liner. Leave my skin feeling smooth and clean when rinsed off. Recommend! I received this product for free for an unbiased review by Bloom Effects.
This is a great product, the scent is good. I used to use the magic eraser now I will be using this in lieu of that.

This product does a great job of of removing makeup. The oily consistency gently melts away makeup. It's also marketed as a facial cleanser but I didn't enjoy it. It doesn't leave my skin feeling clean. I always follow it up with my normal facial cleanser. I was given this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

I'm a bit disappointed this does not perform like it claims on the packaging. When I apply this to dry skin it takes a lot of rubbing and a long time (compared to other similar products) to turn into a (barely) oil consistency. Because of that I would avoid using this around the eye area due to all the tugging and dragging of the skin. It also stings the eyes! I definitely need to use another cleanser after this one because it leaves an oily residue when applied on dry skin. I do appreciate that it has no scent. Does a decent job of removing my light makeup. I would use this as a regular cleanser instead.
I love cleansing balms, and this is such a unique option. The texture is super silky and emulsifies well. The scent is mild and unobtrusive. Leaves my skin clean but not stripped.

avis.titre: Really gentle, no breakouts so far
avis.texte: This cleansing jelly is SO smooth. At the beginning I thought it's too gentle to clean anything but it actually did great job. I double cleanse and use micellar water prior. But it finished my skin well and it didn't feel tight at all. Also I tend to break out from new products and I didn't so it's a good sign. On a friendly note the packaging is this gorgeous two colored shade :).
I love how this cleansing leaves my face feeling fresh and clean after using it. It washes a lot of the oil off my face which leaves my face feeling soft and smooth.

avis.titre: Great cleanser, not my favorite make-up remover
avis.texte: I received Royal Tulip Cleansing Jelly Cleanser for free from BzzAgent in exchange for my honest review. The name initially made me expect a light floral scent, but the product is actually fragrance-free (which may be a benefit for those who prefer unscented skincare). I was also surprised to learn that it functions as both a makeup remover and a facial cleanser, since the front of the tube simply says "cleansing jelly." When used on dry skin as directed, the jelly quickly transforms into an oil and does dissolve makeup. However, the instructions weren't very clear about what to do after it turns into oil. I ended up wiping it off before moving to the next step, and my skin still felt quite oily at that stage. The oily feeling was stronger than I personally prefer, which made the makeup-removal step less enjoyable for me. When I used it on wet skin as a cleanser, it emulsified into a milky texture that rinsed off easily. This step was the highlight for me — my skin felt very smooth, soft, and clean without feeling stripped or oily. I never saw a visual difference in my skin, but it definitely felt clean. Overall, I think this product would work best as a gentle facial cleanser but not as part of a double-cleansing routine. While it does remove makeup, the unclear instructions and the oily feel turned me off, and I personally wouldn't purchase it as a dual-purpose cleanser.

I love this cleanser! There's no scent, which is a huge bonus, not even a light subtle smell, there's absolutely nothing- it's great! This product lathers up nicely. It easily removes all of my makeup and is very gently exfoliating. It's a great product for those of us that have very sensitive skin!

I really love this cleansing jelly. It removes makeup very effectively without needing to scrub too hard. After rinsing, my skin feels completely clean but not stripped or tight. The lipids in the formula help keep my face hydrated and soft, so it doesn't leave that dry, squeaky feeling. It's a great balance between cleansing well and maintaining moisture.

avis.titre: It cleanses my skin very well
avis.texte: I always double cleanse my skin. First i use oil to remove all makeup and then use this to clean my skin after. It cleans my skin well, however a bit dry for my liking. Overall i still thinks this is a good cleanser, but when i have heavy makeup then ill definitely reach for it.

I was sent this for complimentary purposes. I am enjoying this jelly cleanser. I love the texture and it helps cleans and gets my makeup off sooo smoothly!! It doesn't take a lot of scrubbing and it smells sooo good. I would recommend this for sure.

I received this product FREE from BuzzAgent, in exchange for my honest review. Y'all! This Royal Tulip Jelly Cleanser from Bloom Effects is holy grail, I'm not ever going to be without it. It does exactly what it says it does. It melts off your makeup! And not in minutes, we're talking seconds! Even the most stubborn makeup. We're talking matte, dewy, powder, cream blush, bronzer, all gone in seconds! The scent is subtle, yet noticeable. I'm so impressed with this jelly cleanser it's unreal. It works like magic. When used on dry skin it just melts away. When you add water, it turns in this perfect creamy, rich lather. Which ever you prefer to use this, it will remove your makeup! The formula is lightweight, it slightly feels a bit greasy but it isn't. Once you rinse it off, it leaves your face makeup free and clean with just the right amount of moisture left behind. All while not leaving you oily either. This jelly cleanser is truly incredible at what it does! Packaging is adorable too! Stocking up because, new staple, unlocked! Literally, it's just such a quick and easy, super effective cleanser for even the most stubborn makeup! I highly highly recommend!

Really liking the Royal Tulip Cleansing Jelly. The jelly texture feels lightweight and refreshing, and it cleans my skin without leaving it dry or tight. My face feels soft and balanced after using it. Only giving 4 stars because it struggles a bit with heavier makeup, but overall it's a solid everyday cleanser.

The Bloomeffects Royal Tulip Cleansing Jelly is a marvelous product. It rinses off easily and doesn't dry your face out. Not overly scented and is easy to use. I would definitely purchase this product at a reasonable price.
This product is fantastic at removing makeup, and feels very gentle. I appreciate the fact that it's fragrance free and it's heavy. It goes on and rinses off very lightweight.

avis.titre: I would absolutely buy this again and again!
avis.texte: I was hesitant at first but after using this product daily for the last week, my skin has never been as clear and smooth!

avis.titre: Great cleanser that maintains your moisture barrier
avis.texte: So I'm not sure what I was expecting with this product at first. I read the label and saw that it was 96% oil and it was great for removing make up and that it was a cleansing balm that you can use on either wet or dry skin. It said it was fragrance free but for some reason when I rubbed it with one of my fingers before applying it to my face and smelled it, to me it smelled exactly like strawberry frosted or jelly donuts. Yum! It went on smoothly and I could tell that there was a little bit of oil or moisturiser left behind to help my skin barrier from drying out but it didn't feel greasy at all and my fingers were clean. Thanks for letting me try this free product!

This cleansing jelly is the best! It took off my makeup with little to no effort! I even took off my lashes with it. It feels so good on my skin and when I added water it felt like my skin was getting so clean. My skin was left feeling so soft and hydrated.

I've been using the Royal Tulip Cleansing Jelly (45ml) and honestly, I'm pleasantly surprised. The texture is lightweight and jelly-like, which feels really refreshing on the skin. It lathers gently and removes makeup and daily buildup without leaving my face feeling stripped or tight. What I like most is that my skin feels clean but still soft and hydrated afterward. The 45ml size is also perfect for travel or trying it out before committing to a full size. Overall, it's a gentle, effective cleanser that works well for everyday use, especially if you prefer something light and non-drying.

I have always used an oil for makeup remover and this stuff feels less heavy and removes my makeup so well. It leaves me feeling soft not greasy, clean and refreshed. My skin felt great all night after using it. Sometimes with oil even after cleansing after it felt sticky. This makes my skin feel breathable and clean.

avis.titre: The Royal Tulip Cleansing Jelly is a superb beauty product!c
avis.texte: It is not only luxurious and fragrance but it is just as effective. I have used several cleansers over the years and this is on par with one of my favorite cleansers of all time. It smells divine and as I wash my face, it is does not leave my face stripped of essentials oils and dry. My face feels nourished and moisturized and soft to the touch. I am impressed by it's ingredients and it is going to become a staple in my morning routine. I highly recommend this jelly cleanser.

This product works really well I noticed a big difference after using this cleansing gel it left my face feeling so refreshed and clean my skin was very hydrated and soft I really like this cleansing gel

I've been using the facial cleanser for a few days and every day I like it a little more. First of all the aroma is very soft, removes makeup very well and once you add a little water it emulsifies and a milk is made that refreshes and softens my skin, at the end when I rinse my skin is like never before, soft, hydrated, super clean and nothing cardboard. It's definitely a facial cleanser that I recommend 100%

I love that you can use this on wet or dry skin! On dry skin as a jelly that transforms into an oil or on wet skin that transforms into a milky cleanser! I used it as a double cleanser and it took off all my makeup! Very impressed! My skin is sensitive and this did not break me out and does not have a scent. A win win for me! I was sent this product for an honest review and honestly I'm purchasing another when I run out!
Loved the consistency of the product and left my skin so smooth and hydrated

This is by far the best makeup cleanser I have tried. A small amount of the cleansing jelly lifts away all my makeup including my mascara gently and effortlessly. It rinses well without leaving any residue. My skin feels soft and this does not strip the skin. I love that this is fragrance free because who needs such an irritant. I received this complimentary product in exchange for my honest review.

Since I started to used I was amazed how easy was to remove my black head from my pores. It clears really good and after it removes all the impurities from my face and neck, my face and neck fell so clean, smooth and glowing.

avis.titre: I really wanted to like it
avis.texte: Based on other reviews, I was really hopeful for this to be my new "go to" for cleansing. Unfortunately it fell short. I love the texture of the jelly but to get the foam I want I have to use a lot. Mixing it with warm water only makes it go so far and I found myself using a ton and still feeling like it wasn't enough lather. The first 4x I tried it - was neutral about it. The smell is a bit off putting for me but most would consider it a natural smell no perfumes. The 5x my skin ended up really red and had remained that way the next day too. I got this product complimentary in exchange for an honest review. I am the type of person to have numerous face washes at one time and thus just isn't one I'd grab.

I have very dry skin so the product has been suitable for me. The jelly turns into a milky oil which helps clear your makeup and feels very easy. I don't like going through multiple steps to remove my makeup, so this product does me the job. I like it that it does not dry my skin.

avis.titre: Skin soft b7t slightly oily feeling
avis.texte: I enjoyed the priduct and it made my skin feel soft, but left my face oily.

I received this product from Bloomeffects in exchange for my honest review. With that said I absolutely love this Bloomeffects royal tulip cleansing jelly makeup melting cleanser. It has no scent which I appreciate. It comes out as a jelly then melts down while cleansing my makeup away. It does not stripped my skin in fact it leaves my skin feeling clean and supple feeling. It removes my makeup so easily and I absolutely love it.

I tested this cleanser with a full face of makeup, including full-coverage foundation, regular eyeliner, and waterproof eyeliner to really see how it performs. The texture is beautiful and unique. The jelly melts into a silky oil as you massage it onto dry skin, which feels very luxurious and gentle. It spreads easily and allows you to thoroughly break down makeup without tugging at the skin. Once water is added, it transforms into a soft milky cleanser that rinses comfortably. It removed foundation and regular makeup effortlessly. With waterproof eyeliner, it helped loosen and break it down significantly. For very long-wear or waterproof formulas, I found that spending a little extra time massaging gives the best results. What really stands out is how my skin feels afterward — incredibly soft, smooth, and silky. It does not leave my skin feeling tight or stripped. Instead, it feels hydrated, balanced, and comfortable. My complexion looked fresh and healthy after cleansing. Compared to other oil cleansers and balms I've tried, this one feels lighter and more elegant, and the transformation from jelly to oil to milk makes the cleansing experience feel like a skincare ritual. I would absolutely purchase this product for everyday use and would recommend it to friends or family who prefer gentle, hydrating cleansers that leave the skin feeling nourished.

I love that you can use this on dry or wet skin. I like using it both ways, when I have on makeup and when I don't. Skin feels really clean and hydrated afterwards. I also enjoy that it seems to be fragrance free because it doesn't have any scent that I can tell. I would definitely repurchase this!! Highly recommend.

avis.titre: Based on my experience, I will purchase again!
avis.texte: At night I apply a small amount to my damp skin, gently massage it into my face in circular motions to break down dirt, oil and make-up and then rinse off with warm water. I've noticed my face feels clean, soft and hydrated. It also doesn't require a lot of product to get good results.

I'll start by saying I have pretty sensitive skin. This cleanser was a dream. I love the texture and the smell is heavenly. It did a great job and removing my makeup while leaving my skin soft and hydrated. I usually have to apply moisturizer immediately after cleansing but purposely waited a while and my skin actually felt hydrated enough to skip my moisturizer!

I was gifted this product for free in exchange for my honest review. This cleansing jelly is a new favorite of mine. I love that it doubles as a 2-in-1 product. I apply it to my face dry and it melts off my makeup with ease. Then I follow up with a little bit of water and go back in a second time and it does a fantastic job at cleansing my skin. Very cool product, that truly works. It leaves my face feeling clean and soft. Plus, I've had no issues with irritation. This product has made my skin routine a lot more convenient. Love!
